metadata.description: The sharaqi workflow: Opus orchestrates, cheaper models implement, with risk-scaled verification and review.

plugins.name: sharaqi
plugins.description: /sharaqi do <task>: Opus orchestrates and plans only when needed; the cheapest model that gets it right (Haiku or Sonnet, effort at most medium) implements; checks and review scale with the risk, and the report states only what was actually verified.
